title: Starbucks Green Marble Swirl Pattern Small Mug Cup Christmas Seasonal 11 oz 2022
descriptionText:
This Starbucks coffee mug is a must-have for any collector! Featuring a unique green marble swirl pattern with a vibrant red handle, this mug is perfect for the holiday season. Made in China and created in 2022, this original piece of advertising memorabilia is sure to impress.

With a capacity of 11 oz, this mug is perfect for enjoying your favorite hot beverage. Whether you're a coffee or tea lover, this mug is sure to become a cherished addition to your collection. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this one-of-a-kind piece!
